rows.title: Copy of Newspaper Publication
rows.summary: Balkrishna Paper Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication:Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we enclose herewith the copies of the Notice in Form RSC 4, published in (1)  Business Standard  and (2) Navshakti (Marathi) Newspapers on October 17, 2026, pertaining to petition admitted before the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench ( Hon ble Tribunal ) for reduction of share capital of the Company. The copies of aforesaid newspaper clippings will also be available on the website of the Company at www.bpml.inKindly acknowledge and take the above on records.
